summary: The episode discusses how institutional participation has fundamentally changed Bitcoin's market structure, with Coinbase leading institutional buying and dampening volatility compared to 2017. Guest Avi Fellman predicts BTC will reach fair value between 75k-150k and then trade based on real rates and geopolitical risk, with 70% probability of a rounded top versus blow-off top. Ethereum is viewed negatively due to losing its moral narrative and social value as builders migrate to alternative layer ones, with EIP1559 expected to trigger a final rally before other layer ones catch up. Retail activity has shifted to small-cap Uniswap coins rather than established altcoins.
